Passion drives me to build systems that don’t just function—they redefine what’s possible. In adtech, where milliseconds matter and scale is non-negotiable, I thrive at the intersection of innovation and execution. My work isn’t about writing code; it’s about crafting infrastructure that powers real-world impact, from campaign analytics to real-time bidding. I’m wired to solve complex problems, optimize performance, and turn ambiguity into clarity.  

At AdvertiseNow Technologies, I architect and scale backend systems that fuel the next era of digital advertising. My focus? Building resilient, high-throughput services with Go and AWS, while ensuring PostgreSQL handles petabytes of data with precision. I also design REST APIs that act as bridges between data pipelines and actionable insights, all while keeping Linux systems running like clockwork.  

Last year, I spearheaded a rewrite of our analytics engine using Go, slashing query latency by 40% and unlocking new revenue streams. I also automated monitoring with Prometheus, cutting downtime by 75% and giving our team proactive visibility. These aren’t just wins—they’re blueprints for how tech should evolve.  

I’m seeking challenges that push the boundaries of what’s achievable. If you’re building the future of adtech and want a partner who turns “what if” into “what’s next,” let’s connect. I’m not just looking for a job—I’m looking to shape the landscape.
